content: Yosefbed Fero Ye Kiyuum Weng Id Kedmengkandoon
Weeb ayoob dowan kereen ye yondem, Idyip yi king Fero kiyuum wedmoone, ye kuu ok Nail kebed yaa doreen.
Kwane, buromakau darewoob darewoob bingbingmo ediib kuu ok yirimbed yeedere yaroniib, kereek doboob ok kebed yaa ane doriib.
Kwane, buromakau yena konokonomo murubia didban ediib ok yirimbed yeedere yaro miniwen. Mene yena ok kebed yaa doriib yaa dabokne doriib.
Kwane, buromakau konokonomo kumbed buromakau darewoob bingbingmo kuu aniwen. Kwane, Fero kuu yaro demboon.
Ye angkon ika angkene kiyuum maa wedmoone, yakom irok mimo yaambed id ediib darewoob darewoob amun amun ire yumune weneen.
Wonoone, yakom maa konokonomo dembene id ediib iroone nuub niminbed wuuroone koknoon kumbed
yakom id darewoob darewoob amun amun kuu been yoobkoon. Kwane Fero yeederene wedmoonka kiyuum waan.

Ye kuu meenmi darewoob kameen amkimo kereene, Idyip aom indob ayoob yi karub, inamen bangbangiib kuye karub weng kowoone meneniiwa, kiyuum kuu daandoon, kumban karub kuu miniwen kuu weng id anam kuu ma korokbenindo.
King yaa ye wain ok koni ye karubbed Fero yaa yedmoon “Ne kibik ika meenmaan kuu ne anuk kuu ambarakmaan.
Kurin kuu ne yoom flawa ongmidan yi korok yoom ebbed norin wandenekore, nub kuu eb yaa oonidan yi korok yambiwoom wii kamberewen.
Kuyaom kuu amnoombed nub kiyuum ye idiib yeka yeka wanabuwen.
Hibru kewedman kuu nub yoom doruuwa ye kuu eb yaa oonidan yi korok ye deme karub keroon. Nub kiyuum kuu daanuuwa,

kiyuum weng id kuu yembed nub yaa kedmengkandoon. Kwamune yedmoon arebmo, nub yaa komo kwanandameen kuu nub yaa kwanoon. Yedmewenkob, flawa ongmidan yi korok ye korok kuu wande ye id kuu kan at yitkang arimbed kaaroon. Ne kuu ne deme yumbon kuu ika nenkowewen.” andoon.
Kwane, Ferombed weng kowoone, wii ambiwoombed Yosef nenminiiwe, bomi de ebkad yeweb debe kwanoone, kirodmo Feroyiib yaa nenminiwen.
Kwane, Ferombed Yosef yaa yedmoon “Ne kiyuum wedmaan kumban, karub kanembed ma kedmengkandindo. Kumban ne wengambaraanka eb kuu kiyuum wengambere id kedmengkandimameeb.” andoone,
Yosefbed Fero yaa inande yedmoon “Ne kuu yiminban, kumban eb dowaken kuu kwamune kowe, Godbed eb kiyuum weng id kuu kedmengkabdaneen.” andoon.
Kwane, Ferombed Yosef yaa yedmoon “Ne kiyuum angka wedmaane, ne kuu ok Nail kebed angka doriin.
Kwane, buromakau darewoob darewoob bingbingmo ediib kuu ok yirimbed yeedere yaroniib, kereek doboob ok kebed yaa ane doriib.
Kuyi yondem buromakau yena konokonomo miin murubia didban ediib yeedere yaro meniib kii. Kwamune kuu Idyip ambibkin korem keyaom kee ne ma kwamune wedmindo.
Kwane, buromakau konokonomo murubia didban ediib kumbed buromakau ibduruk dembiwen kuu korem ane dowan keriwen.
Kwane aniwen kumban, yi ma kwanindo areb, yi kuu konokonomo miin murubia didban kuu kwanamo. Kwane ne dembaan.
Kiyuum maa kuu kei. Yakom irok mimo yaambed id ediib darewoob darewoob amun amun ire yumune weneen.
Wonoone, yakom maa konokonomo dembene id ediib iroone, nuub niminbed wuuroone koknoon kumbed
yakom id darewoob darewoob amun amun kuu been yoobkoon. Indob ayoob yi karub yaa ne kiyuum daandaan kuu weng id ne yaa maawindo.” andoon.
Kwane, Yosefbed Fero yaa yedmenoon “Godbed komo awinandameen kuu eb yaa korokbebdoon. Kiyuum ayoob kuu ye weng id kuu ibmo.
Buromakau darewoob darewoob amun amun ediib, yakom darewoob darewoob amun amun ediib ye weng id mimo kuu weeb ediib.
Buromakau konokonomo murubia didban ediib yoman yeediriweniib, yakom konokonomo nuub niminbed wuuroone koknoon ediib ye weng id mimo kuu weeb ediib kuu animaniibban keraneen.
Eb yaa nembed kee yedmebdaan kuu kui. Godbed komo awinandameen kuu eb yaa korokbebdoon.
Weeb ediib kuu Idyip ambibkin korem aom kuu animan yewudmo kere wananeen,
kumban yoman kuu weeb ediib aom kuu am kainaneena animaniibban keraneen. Kwane, Idyip aom kuu animan yewudmo kuu nonondandaniiwa am kaini kuu Idyip okad yimin yimin yaa waneene monmaraneen.
Anam, animan yewudmo kuu ika meenmaibban amborom kuu animaniibban keri kuu miin arewa keraneen.
Eb kuu kiyuum ayoob wedmewen ye id kuu anam Godbed aron doboobban kwanandameen, angkon inamen ma kerokban.
Eb kuu Fero kowe, inamen bangbangiib kedmengkandi yemoon ye karub wedmekore, Idyip ye okad yi korok nenkowe.

Kwane, ebbed okad yimin yimin yaa animan ooni ye korok be nongkobe. Yi dowad kuu animan yewudmo ye weeb ediib aom animan wanabi kuu bekorib, andokbe wenore angkoyiib nongkobe anded mimo bekorib, animan angkara animan yi yariman ika bangkandimamaniib.
Animan baniib kuu taun aombed eb animan nongkobi yi ambiwoom kuu benwenoraniib. Kwanekorib, oonaniib kuu amun.
Animan wenore oonaniib kuu weeb ediib aom Idyip aom animaniibban keraneen ye niindem aom angkon bangkandaniib yeman. Kwananiib kumbed karub mungi bobnaibban.” andoon.
Ferombed Idyip Ooni Ye Dowad Yosef Nenkowoon
Kwane, Fero yoom ye korok korok yoom weng kandekorib, weng amun ande meeniwen
kowe, Ferombed yi yaa yedmoon “Karub mim kwamune kee ma wedmaubban, God ye kingkiniib kee.” andekore
Ferombed Yosef yaa yedmoon “Korem kee Godbed korokbebdoon kowe, eb kuu inamen bangbangiib kedmengkandi yemooniib kuu karub ma kwaneyiibban kowe,
eb kuu nembed ne ambibkindaniib ne korok korokiib ye korok nenkowaniine, eb weng kondaneeb kuu eb wengmo awine kandaniib. Nembedmo kuu eb korok kii.” andekore,
ika yedmoon “Kibik kee Idyip ambibkin korem aom kee ebbed ooni korok nenkowaan.” andekore,
Ferombed ye dingki kanding ye kuruyiib biande Yosef ye dingki birid ari derenekore, ebkad doboob amuniib derenekore, gold itoob ye kongkono yaa niinenoon

kowe, Fero yaa wengongke ye dabderem aom dobiri ye karub keroon. Kwane, Ferombed yedmoonkob ye hos mamaayiib ye hos yoman ari dobiriwed kirod yarebi yeman aningko seriot mamaayiib nekwiiwe, Yosef kuu nenkowoone, karub yena yidin wene ika ika baandiib “Angkane karub keyaa bumangkime.” andiiwe, Yosef kuu Fero yaa wengongke ye dabderem aom dobiri ye karub keroon kuu Ferombed Idyipdan yaa korokbendoon.
Kwane, Ferombed Yosef yaa yedmoon “Ne kuu Fero, kumban karub kanembed eb yimin andiyiibban kuu yoon o dingki ma kankoonaanban, Idyip korem aom.” andekore,

Ferombed Yosef yaa Idyip wengbed aningko maa Sefenat Fanea konoon. Kwane, taun aningko On yi karub dore yi god dore wedyiri dobiri ye karub Potifera ye dana mungkan Asenat konoona awanoon. Yosef kuu weeb 30yiib yaambed Idyipdan yi king Fero ye yumbon aombed wene Fero ye deme andowe Idyip korem aom yeka awine deweneboon.
Weeb ediib ibduruk kuyaom okad kuu animan yewudmo id ire wonoon kowe,
Yosefbed animan korem Idyip aom kuu id ire wonoon taun dia kuu taun kwamune aom be wenoroon, taun mimim kui.
Animan id korem kuu kimingkindeban, karamok kebed yaa kubuk mimim areb kowe, Yosefbed kimingki kuu korondoon.
Kuu yaron kuu Yosef ye meed karub dana ayoob ye wonong Asenatbed wanabeen.
Yosef ye mingki ibduruk wooneene yedmoon “Nambe awene yaa meeniyiib ne durud yewed koremiib Godbed boona nonondandaan kowe yaningko kuu Menase
.” andoon.
Yosef ye mingki maa wooneene yedmoon “Ne kuu okad maa aom dobere durud yewed kandaan, kumban Godbed amun keruwoone yowiib keraan kowe, yaningko kuu Efraim
.” andoon.
Idyip aom animan yewudmo ye weeb ediib kuu mene yimin wandoone,
animaniibban ye weeb ediib andowe muneen. Kwane, Yosefbed komo dakmoon kuu kwanoon. Ambibkin maa korem aom kuu animaniibban kere wonoon, kumban Idyip aom kuu animan yemooniib.
Idyipdan animaniibban keroona wedmekoriwa, mene Fero yaa animan dowad ameng kamiwen kowe, Ferombed Idyipdan yaa yedmendoon “Yosefiib yaa winibko, yembed komo yedmendoka kwanime.” andoon.
Animan kuu Idyip korem aom dowan kere weneene, Yosefbed animan ambib nandoone Idyipdanbed Yosef yaa andowe berengkiwen.
Ambibkin korem kwangkon animaniibban mungi ye yewedbed yiminban kowe, korem meneniiwa, Yosefiib yaa Idyip aombed animan andowe berengkiwen.

footnotes.text: Menase yaningko ye weng id kuu “Nonondandi”.
Efraim yaningko ye weng id kuu “Ne yob kuu ayoob keraan”.
